easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.
